isInitialized(address).details: Returns if the module was already initialized for a provided smartaccount

onInstall(bytes).details: This function is called by the smart account during installation of the module

params.data: arbitrary data that may be required on the module during `onInstall` initialization MUST revert on error (i.e. if module is already enabled)

onUninstall(bytes).details: This function is called by the smart account during uninstallation of the module

params.data: arbitrary data that may be required on the module during `onUninstall` de-initialization MUST revert on error

processStxDataObject(address,address,byt.details: Processes the data object for the SafeAccount fusion mode      This function will decode the signature data and verify      the Merkle proof for the superTx hash.      It will return the data required for the further 1271/7739 signature validation:      proper hash, and a signature.

params.dataHash: The hash of the data object
params.sigData: The signature data for the data object

returns._0: bytes32 The hash, that was signed

processStxDataObjectFor7780Flow(address,.details: This function is used to process the data object for the 7780 flow

params.dataHash: The hash of the data object
params.sigData: The signature data for the data object

returns._0: bytes32 The hash of the data object
returns._1: bytes The signature data for the data object

processStxUserOpData(address,bytes32,byt.details: Processes the userOp data for the Safe account mode      This function will decode the signature data and verify      the Merkle proof for the superTx hash.      If required, it will execute a Safe transaction. param address account The account that requested userOp processing

params.sigData: The signature data for the userOp

returns._0: bytes The encoded data : timestamps, meeHash, and a clean signature

validateSignatureWithData(bytes32,bytes,.details: Parses the expected signer from data and      validates a signature over the userOpHash.

params.data: The data to validate the signature against.
params.hash: The userOpHash to validate the signature over.

returns._0: True if the signature is valid, false otherwise.
